title: On Containing the names of forty men
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：contain　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 contain 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the postman ① contained the names of forty men with great care, and every sender in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the postman ② contains the names of forty men on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ contain the names of forty men at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ contained the names of forty men before — a line in the list for June 1948 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Containing the names of forty men with great care, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ contain her anger till the door shut on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Contain her anger till the door shut at once and never mention it again.

By 1961 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new sender from the next office ⑧ contains her anger till the door shut with great care every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the box, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ contained the names of forty men again when nobody else would.

⑩ To contain the names of forty men, my mother said in 1966, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody contains the names of forty men on the same day again and somebody must contain the names of forty men with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 包含（一般过去式 contained the names of forty men：1954 年邮差头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 包含（一般现在 contains the names of forty men：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 包含（不定式 to contain the names of forty men：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 包含（过去完成时 had contained the names of forty men：1948 年六月的收发清单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 包含（动名词 containing the names of forty men 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 克制（contain her anger till the door shut：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去克制她的气性一直忍到门关上）
G. v. 克制（contain her anger till the door shut：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 包含（后段两处：新来的寄信人照例 contains her anger till the door shut，而母亲又一次 contained the names of forty men）

answers.why: contain 意为“包含”，1954 年邮差小心翼翼地包含四十个人的名字，那是邮局里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 contained。
contain 意为“包含”，自那以后邮差当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 contains。
contain 意为“包含”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯包含四十个人的名字”，此处为不定式 to contain the names of forty men。
contain 意为“包含”，收发清单里 六月 那行字说明早在 1961 年之前就有人包含过，故用过去完成时 had contained。
contain 意为“包含”，邮差说“包含四十个人的名字这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 containing the names of forty men 作主语。
contain 意为“克制”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去克制她的气性一直忍到门关上”，should ever 之后用原形 contain her anger till the door shut。
contain 意为“克制”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻克制她的气性一直忍到门关上（contain her anger till the door shut at once），以后再也不要提起。
contain 意为“包含”，新来的寄信人每个星期都照例克制她的气性一直忍到门关上，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 contains。
contain 意为“包含”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地包含四十个人的名字，用一般过去式 contained 叙述。
contain 意为“包含”，结尾那句是母亲 1966 年的话：要包含四十个人的名字，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和邮局记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 contain 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1954 the postman contained the names of forty men with great care, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the postman contains the names of forty men on the same day whenever the office asks.
Containing the names of forty men with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever contain her anger till the door shut on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new sender from the next office contains her anger till the door shut with great care every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother contained the names of forty men again, and the office remembered that half.
